module_summary: Parameterized arbiter: two priority encoders (plain and round-robin-masked) pick a requester; registered one-hot grant, valid and encoded index, with optional blocking until acknowledge.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: per-port request vector fed to both priority encoders

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: indicates a grant is active; used for ack-blocking hold

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: binary index of granted port output

anchors.name: request_valid
anchors.why: any request present; gates new grant computation

anchors.name: request_index
anchors.why: priority-encoded winner index loaded into grant_encoded

anchors.name: mask_reg
anchors.why: round-robin mask of ports above last winner; disabled by default parameter

anchors.name: masked_request_valid
anchors.why: masked request present; selects masked encoder result in round-robin mode

groups.name: Priority encoders
groups.description: Plain and masked priority encoders selecting winning requester

groups.name: Round-robin mask
groups.description: Masks requests at or below last winner for round-robin fairness

groups.name: Grant registers
groups.description: Registered grant, valid and index; hold until ack/request drop when blocking
